 Jackson Hole News&Guide readers who open their cellphone, laptop or tablet on Wednesday mornings will find their news routine uninterrupted this week. But print subscribers who journey to their mailboxes anticipating the print paper may be disappointed. Due to the Veterans Day federal holiday, U.S. Post Office personnel won't deliver papers until Thursday. Subscribers are welcome to log onto JHNewsAndGuide.com to get the headlines until the print product arrives, or pick up one at dozens of retail locations valleywide. 
 And consider celebrating Veterans Day by thanking a veteran for their service and attending the American Legion / VFW ceremony at 11 a.m. in Town Square.
 Contact Johanna Love at 307-732-7071 or jlove@jhnewsandguide.com .
